about.meta.title: About · Still Here
about.meta.description: Get to know Still Here, a platform for responsible animal adoption.
about.p1: Still Here is a responsible adoption platform that connects animal welfare NGOs with families who want to adopt.
about.p2: Our goal is to make it easier for animals in need of a home to meet people who are committed to giving love and care.
about.p3: We are a non-profit social and educational project focused on promoting responsible adoption and fighting animal abandonment.
responsible.meta.title: Responsible Adoption · Still Here
responsible.meta.description: Learn what responsible adoption is and how it helps animals.
responsible.intro: Adopting is an act of love that takes responsibility and commitment. Before you adopt, consider:
responsible.item1: Do you have enough space for the animal?
responsible.item2: Can you cover food, healthcare and wellbeing?
responsible.item3: Does everyone in the family agree to the adoption?
responsible.item4: Are you willing to spend time on care and walks?
responsible.outro: Responsible adoption means making sure the animal gets a dignified and happy life for good.

terms.meta.title: Terms of Use · Still Here
terms.meta.description: Terms of use for the Still Here responsible animal adoption platform.
terms.s1.title: 1. About the platform
terms.s1.body: Still Here is a social and educational platform that connects animal welfare NGOs with people interested in responsible adoption. The project is a non-profit and is part of a university outreach initiative.
terms.s2.title: 2. Use of the platform
terms.s2.body: Anyone can browse the public Still Here pages to see available animals and information about partner NGOs. An account is only required for NGOs that want to register animals and manage their profiles.
terms.s3.title: 3. NGO responsibilities
terms.s3.body: Registered NGOs are responsible for the information they publish, including animal details, photos and contact information. NGOs must keep their information up to date and act in accordance with animal protection legislation in force.
terms.s4.title: 4. Adoption process
terms.s4.body: Still Here makes it easier to advertise animals for adoption, but it is not directly involved in the adoption process. All contact between interested people and NGOs happens independently, through the contact channels provided (WhatsApp, email, Instagram). Responsibility for the adoption lies entirely with the NGO and the adopter.
terms.s5.title: 5. Donations
terms.s5.body: The platform allows NGOs to publish their PIX keys to receive donations. Still Here does not process, store or intermediate payments. Every financial transaction is solely the responsibility of the donor and the NGO.
terms.s6.title: 6. Limitation of liability
terms.s6.body: Still Here is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind. The project is not liable for direct or indirect damages arising from the use of the platform, from information published by NGOs, or from the outcomes of adoption processes.
terms.s7.title: 7. Privacy
terms.s7.body: The platform only collects the data strictly needed to operate: NGO registration details (email, password) and animal data. Access credentials are managed by Firebase Authentication and are not accessible to the project team.
terms.s8.title: 8. Changes
terms.s8.body: These terms may be updated at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes means the new terms are accepted.
